sample_unit: multiple-choice questions (500 internal, 260 external); open-ended question count not reported

links.outcome: Dental QA accuracy of knowledge-graph-grounded RAG versus baseline LLMs and chunk-based RAG
links.effect: Absolute accuracy improvement of 0.04 (95% CI 0.03, 0.06) on 500 internal questions and 0.05 (95% CI 0.04, 0.07) on 260 external questions; open-ended scores up to 0.78 points higher on a 5-point scale.
links.quote: DGADS leveraged knowledge from DentalKG to outperform baseline models, achieving absolute accuracy improvements of 0.04 (95% CI: 0.03, 0.06) on 500 internal questions and 0.05 (95% CI: 0.04, 0.07) on 260 external questions.

unlisted_practices: Agentic RAG module that assesses sufficiency of retrieved knowledge-graph information and retrieves external sources when needed

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an agentic knowledge-graph RAG system to ground LLM responses and mitigate hallucination in dental question-answering benchmarks, comparing it against baseline LLMs without/with standard chunk-based RAG.
